summary: Iteration 239 - Strict Separation Validation for Somatic Yoga, Chair Yoga, and Fascia Stretching. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests confirm all three are separate with distinct identities, independent API calls, and proper menu entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 239 verified strict separation: (1) Backend endpoints /api/somatic-yoga, /api/chair-yoga, /api/fascia-stretching each return exactly 14 items (4 free + 10 premium). (2) Frontend routes /somatic-yoga, /chair-yoga, /fascia-stretching render distinct page identities with unique headers, descriptions, and data-testids. (3) Chair Yoga page calls /api/chair-yoga (NOT /api/somatic-yoga) and shows accessibility-focused content. (4) Fascia Stretching page calls /api/fascia-stretching and shows fascia-specific content including 'This stream is separate from Somatic Yoga and Chair Yoga'. (5) Main menu shows separate entries for all three: Somatic Yoga, Chair Yoga, Fascia Stretching. (6) TopNav and BottomNav include separate entries for Chair Yoga and Fascia Stretching. (7) Legacy /somatic route still works (Somatic Movement page). (8) No regressions detected.
